name: Pomodoro
author: Johanns Gregorian
description: A Pomodoro timer for the Omarchy shell: focus and break countdowns in the bar, a control panel with one-tap presets, and a notification, chime, or full-screen break view when a session ends.

barWidget.description: Focus and break countdown with presets, start, pause, reset and skip.

schema.label: Focus session length in minutes: 15, 25, 50 or 90
Break length: short (5 min) or long (15 min)
Send a desktop notification when a session ends
Play a short sound when a session ends
Cover every monitor with a break view during breaks
